brief:
Israel's defense minister accused Iran of pursuing chemical weapons development and signaled readiness for joint military action against Tehran, Al-Monitor reported. The accusation comes as the Israeli government intensifies pressure for strikes on Iranian targets, though a U.S. source has questioned the credibility of the allegations.

Opposition to Prime Minister Netanyahu's push for military intervention has mounted among both domestic and international figures. The timing of the chemical weapons accusation coincides with broader regional tensions and Israeli calls for expanded military operations in the Middle East.
dek: Israel says Iran is pursuing chemical weapons and signals readiness for joint military action, but a US source questions the allegations as opposition mounts to Netanyahu’s push for strikes.
title: Israeli defense minister accuses Iran of developing chemical weapons
